item.title: CL to return with new single on Nov. 20
item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
CL will release the digital single “Iconic” on Nov. 20, marking her first solo release in five years. The Black Label unveiled concept photos for the upcoming single through its official social media channels late Monday, days after announcing that CL had signed an exclusive contract with the agency. item.title: Former Ador CEO referred to prosecutors over NewJeans' attempted contract termination
item.description:
Korea Herald • Contract / agency
Seoul Mapo Police Station referred Min Hee-jin, former CEO of K-pop agency Ador and current head of Ooak Records, to prosecutors Monday on suspicion of breach of trust over her alleged involvement in NewJeans' attempt to terminate its exclusive contracts with the agency in 2024. Min denied the allegations and questioned how details of the police investigation had reached the media before she was formally notified of the decision. item.title: NewJeans tops 600m Spotify streams with debut single ‘Attention’
item.description:
Korea Herald • Debut / new group
NewJeans now has five songs with over 600 million plays on Spotify, with “Attention” the latest to join the list, agency Ador said Monday, citing the platform's data. “Attention” follows “Ditto,” “OMG,” “Super Shy” and “Hype Boy” in reaching the milestone, while “New Jeans” and “ETA” each have more than 500 million streams.
